title: RUMBLE
description:
Note to WMR usersAlthough RUMBLE is fully playable with a Windows Mixed Reality (WMR) headset, not all of those headsets provide an optimal gameplay experience. We have made a forum post with more information as to which WMR headsets we recommend for playing RUMBLE.

Please visit the Discussions page for more information about the WMR headsets.

Об игреExperience VR combat like you never have beforeRUMBLE's physics-based combat system is both functionally unique, and refreshingly intense!

Improve your newfound EARTHBENDING skills in the GYMThe GYM features all kinds of useful tools to help you learn the basics of bending!

Test your mastery against other fighters in the ARENAEngage in intense 1 on 1 battles against other earthbenders in the ARENA!

Customize your fighting style with SHIFTSTONESShiftstones grant you new abilities that further personalize your combat style!

Unlock NEW powers and equipment as you PLAYEarn all kinds of rewards like new moves and new cosmetics just by playing the game!

Begin your EARTHBENDING journey with RUMBLE TODAY!But there is more! RUMBLE also features...

• THE PARK

Where you can train, hang around, or even play Minigames with up to 6 players!

• CROSSPLAY & CROSS PROGRESSION

No matter what platform you play on, you will be able to play with everyone!

• THE ROCK CAM

An in-game handheld camera with which you can create all sorts of fun photos and videos! 
Note: The Rock Cam is not available on Linux, and by extension, the Steam Frame.

• AND MORE IS ON THE WAY!

Stay tuned for what's next, we're still actively updating RUMBLE with all kinds of exciting new features!
description_short: Master your new earthbending powers and become the greatest martial artist the world has ever seen! Master the moves, craft your combos, and take to the arena to engage in one of the most intense and exciting 1-on-1 VR fighting games out there!
